dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Bruno is an approximately 4-year-old low rider with an adorable face and a lot of personality! He is a social, affectionate, and playful guy who enjoys being around people, though he prefers affection on his own terms. Bruno is an active dog who enjoys his daily walks and spending time with his people. He can become easily overaroused, so he would do best with an experienced adopter who understands canine behavior and is comfortable working with dogs who need help managing their excitement. Bruno will also need medical follow-up care, and his future foster or adopter should be prepared to work with a veterinarian to address his ongoing medical needs.
